name: Nurse and staff retention and burnout-risk prediction for hospitals and nursing homes
verdict: The strongest AI-leverage story in the cluster — a genuine predictive model, not extraction, sized for a segment Laudio, Inovalon and HRBench all skip

name: Facility-side credentialing and compliance oversight for one hospital's medical staff office
verdict: The buyer-side mirror of idea 61 — real 2025-26 NCQA tightening forcing purchases now, a fragmented incumbent field priced for large systems, and a 6,000-member NAMSS channel to sell into

name: AI schedule optimization and coverage forecasting for small-to-mid hospitals and nursing homes
verdict: Real, penalty-backed ratio laws and a genuine forecasting-plus-optimization problem, held back a point because symplr already proves the AI works well at enterprise scale

name: Internal float pool and PRN workforce deployment for a single health system
verdict: A real, already-commercially-validated single-employer category that Vars Health, Syncx and Trusted Works all price for large multi-facility systems, leaving the small end open

name: Physician and specialist coverage-gap forecasting for critical-access and rural hospitals
verdict: The widest-open competitive gap in the cluster, capped by rural hospitals' own financial fragility rather than by the product

name: Language-access interpreter workforce scheduling and Title VI compliance for hospitals
verdict: A real compliance gap with live 2026 OCR enforcement behind it, but a genuinely narrow software niche and the only idea in the cluster that requires a BAA
